description: Enquadramento dos Trechos de drenagem is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Enquadramento dos Trechos de Drenagem do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Downloadable Data, Enquadramento, Trecho de Drenagem, SEMA, DRH. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
